comparison.scope: Identical disk equations, topology and bounds; original 80-byte versus exact 32-byte shadow view; reference/compact order alternates; stream scheduling OFF in both timed modes; identical geometry/light sequence; private hints and visibility reset before setup; initial geometry plus all nine camera/power/position warm-up events recorded separately before each measured block. Warm-up classification is fixed before execution, with no outlier rejection. Timed events have no GPU reads. Separate instrumented work events read 32 counter bytes per separate work event after timing; hardware counter intervals collected only after timed/work events; best-effort frequency/thermal telemetry outside event timing; thermal state not controlled. Callback wait is not GPU completion or input-to-photon latency.
